pillars.name: Science & Credibility
pillars.description: Content anchored in CSIRO or Mayo Clinic research, clinical data, peer-reviewed evidence, or program outcome statistics. The institutional authority angle — no competitor can match this.

pillars.name: Weight Loss Results
pillars.description: Transformation stories, member testimonials, before/after journeys, and program outcome data. Social proof that the program works — real people, real numbers.

pillars.name: Nutrition & Meal Planning
pillars.description: Recipes, meal plans, food education, high-protein eating, low-GI guidance, and practical nutrition tips. The 'what to eat' content that drives saves and shares.

pillars.name: Habit & Behaviour Change
pillars.description: Sustainable habits, mindset shifts, behaviour science, and lifestyle change. The 'how to stick with it' content — motivation, consistency, and the psychology behind lasting change.

pillars.name: GLP-1 & Medication Support
pillars.description: Content for people using or considering GLP-1 weight loss medications (Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, etc.). Positions the program as the ideal structure and support layer alongside medication.

pillars.name: Exercise & Movement
pillars.description: Activity plans, fitness tips, movement for different fitness levels and ages, and the role of exercise in weight management. Accessible, encouraging, non-intimidating.

pillars.name: Promotion & Offers
pillars.description: Program sign-ups, pricing announcements, sales campaigns, health fund discounts, limited-time offers, and product launches. Direct conversion content.
